question: Does exact full-block reuse of a shared tool-session prefix preserve every generated token and reduce real multi-turn elapsed time?
protocol: First twelve corrected-primary trajectories containing more than one model turn, including incorrect sessions. Run every live interaction four times through identical callbacks with alternating ABBA/BAAB policy. Cache only aligned 128-token prefill blocks, each site retains separate KV or delta state. First turn timing includes snapshot creation. Same model, greedy settings, request IDs, and observations. Count total and per-item elapsed ratios, matched streams, number of reused prompt tokens. This is a latency crossover conditional on actual multistep calls.
gate: All complete prompt and output token streams, observations, answers, and statuses identical on all four runs per case. At least 5% lower total session seconds and nonzero reused tokens. Otherwise retain full-prefill default.
